evidence_items.locator: AI Infrastructure and Market Consolidation; Deedy Das quotation

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI ceded nearly half its share.

evidence_items.explanation: Menlo reports Anthropic at 40% and OpenAI at 27% of the enterprise LLM API market. This supports competitive gains, but market share does not identify how many customers transferred; Menlo is an Anthropic investor.

evidence_items.locator: Enterprises Switch Models for Performance, Not Price
evidence_items.explanation: The survey of 150 technical decision-makers finds relatively limited vendor switching across providers. It does not identify the OpenAI-to-Anthropic portion, so it neither proves nor rules out substantial transfers.

evidence_items.locator: Other big moves; paragraph on OpenAI adoption
evidence_items.explanation: Ramp reports December growth for both OpenAI and Anthropic. This cautions against treating Anthropic's growth as customer losses for OpenAI, although simultaneous growth can coexist with switching.
